statement_summary: Written information security program (WISP) made of POL-01, P01, P02, P08
Owner designated Qualified Individual in writing
Annual written risk assessment with SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual evaluation with outside review every second year
Policy review each July and before PTIN renewal
Annual consumer count against the 314.6 threshold
Helpers and contract preparers bound by agreement to this policy and IRC 7216
Written, time-limited exceptions
No contract terms, no client data
Vendor list
Pre-adoption checklist for new applications and features
Annual review of the tax software vendor's SOC 2 report and other providers
Written IRC 6713 and 7216 notice to contractor individuals before access
Owner-started, watched remote support; contractor account with MFA
Named accounts; no shared credentials
MFA on every system that offers it, including clients on the portal
Password manager; no passwords stored in browsers or devices
Helper accounts approved and disabled on the last day; quarterly user review
Device lock after 5 minutes (phone 1 minute)
Sealed emergency access codes held by the owner's attorney
Monthly and filing-season log review; weekly EFIN and PTIN counts
Security change log
Three-level data classification
Restricted data only in approved locations
Full-disk encryption on every device
Portal-only exchange of returns, documents, and Forms 8879
Call-back rule for bank account, address, and email changes
Encrypted backup of the email and file suite with one-year retention
Shredding; device wipe or certified destruction with a record
Written retention schedule; Forms 8879 kept at least 3 years; old IRS authorizations withdrawn
IRC 7216 disclosure and consent rules; no SSNs outside the United States
Automatic updates and antivirus stay on; approved software sources
Router password changed; family devices on the guest network
AI tools only after assessment; no client data without a confirmed IRC 7216 basis; owner checks AI output
Annual security training before filing season; security alerts
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery and confirmation times
IRS report through the Stakeholder Liaison by the next business day after confirmation
FTC, Florida, and other notices per the P08 matrix
No payment without counsel and an OFAC check
Practice continuation agreement with another CPA
